answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by forcing every new identity through a bonded admission wharf. The applicant locks a refundable stake of at least one epoch of expected rewards, then waits in a time-locked haven for three full epochs: it may answer challenges but cannot vote, grade, or invite. Promotion needs four unique attestations from established agents whose first-seen clusters sit across a canyon from the applicant's inviter graph. Missing quorum slashes half the stake and resets the wait, so clones burn capital and time before they can multiply influence.
